summary: Prop trader placed three BUY limits of 4418 (max 5.56x top-5 depth, 2 ticks from touch) between 11:09:42 and 11:09:52, sold 662 at 9998 at 11:10:02, and all three bids were cancelled at 11:10:03.280, the same millisecond as a recorded automated kill switch (intraday loss limit breach). The order is borderline: one-sided, large and cancelled one second after the sell, so Level 2 should check it.

The detector fired on gross size and cancels, which come from the continuous re-pegging. Feature (a) is absent because the orders are pegged children of a parent. Feature (b) is absent because there was no price move and no reversion, and the 2-tick round trip came from a two-sided quoting algorithm. Propose CLOSE_FP.

The detector fired on gross size and a 518 SELL fill followed by cancels. The tape shows a PEGGED algo that re-pegs paired BUY and SELL child orders of two parents at the touch.
